Purported tales about Faust’s life first appeared in print in an anonymously written chapbook, Historia von D. Johann Fausten (1587). Faustus (first published 1604) and Johann Wolfgang von Goethe’s Faust (published 1808 and 1832).

The -th of the Middle English forms is most straightforwardly accounted for as a direct borrowing of a French [θ].
